feeds.title: Wisconsin Public Radio » Politics
feeds.description: Covering breaking news, headlines, providing commentary on the ongoing issues and reports, Wisconsin Public Radio brings you all political news in one place. Since 1917, Wisconsin Public Radio has been a pioneer in radio broadcasting. Educating, informing, and evoking thought have been at the forefront of WPR since its inception.
